items.label: Python foundations
items.detail: Use typed Python modules, errors, generators, asyncio, and packaging in a reviewed repository.

items.label: FastAPI
items.detail: Build documented endpoints with Pydantic schemas, dependencies, and predictable errors.

items.label: PostgreSQL and SQL
items.detail: Design and query relational data, constraints, transactions, and indexes.

items.label: SQLAlchemy and Alembic
items.detail: Implement typed persistence and reversible, reviewed schema migrations.

items.label: Authentication and authorization
items.detail: Demonstrate secure credentials, token lifecycle, and resource-level authorization.

items.label: Testing
items.detail: Write pytest and HTTPX unit, integration, async, and security tests.

items.label: Redis and background work
items.detail: Use caching and durable jobs with idempotency and operational visibility.

items.label: API design
items.detail: Document versioning, pagination, filtering, and error contracts.

items.label: Docker and Compose
items.detail: Reproduce the API and its dependencies locally and deploy it as a container.

items.label: CI/CD and Linux
items.detail: Automate quality gates and explain a Linux/Nginx/cloud deployment.

items.label: LLM integration
items.detail: Integrate Ollama or OpenAI-compatible model APIs with timeouts, streaming, and budgets.

items.label: Structured output and tools
items.detail: Validate model output and safely dispatch allowlisted, authorized tools.

items.label: Embeddings and vector search
items.detail: Build pgvector retrieval with filters and reproducible search experiments.

items.label: RAG and hybrid search
items.detail: Deliver citations, lexical/vector retrieval, reranking, and an abstention path.

items.label: LangGraph workflows
items.detail: Build bounded stateful workflows with persistence and human approval.

items.label: Evaluation and observability
items.detail: Maintain evaluation data and inspect traces, quality, latency, and token use.

items.label: AI security
items.detail: Threat-model prompt injection, data leakage, tenancy, and tool abuse.

items.label: Python backend portfolio
items.detail: Publish a traditional FastAPI project and multiple AI backend projects with reproducible instructions.

items.label: GitHub and technical communication
items.detail: Maintain clean repositories, architecture diagrams, and concise technical demonstrations.

items.label: Remote job readiness
items.detail: Prepare role-targeted CV/LinkedIn, Python/backend interviews, English communication, and applications.
